text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Assad receives Pope Shunda of Egypt.
- Progressive National Front reviews Mideast situation, peace process.
- EU envoy Moratinos defends Europe's role in Mideast peace process.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu voices support for Jewish settlers in the occupied Golan Heights.
- Arab League chief hails French President Chirac's stance on Mideast peace.
- Egyptian Foreign Minister Moussa: Israel's settlement contradicts peace.
- British Labour government pledges better relations with the EU.
- Parliament continues discussion of country's budget.
- Arab press calls for unified stand against Israel's intransigence.
- Another Turkish military delegation visits Israel to discuss strategic cooperation.
- EU envoy Moratinos: I heard the drums of peace in Damascus.
- Israel rejects the European role in the Middle East peace talks and talks about military option.
- Nestle International opens first food and beverage factory in Syria.
